title: Unit – 3 : Session – 2 : SLO – 1  |  Array Stack — Advantages, Disadvantages, Applications
sections: I. Advantages of Array Implementation
Stack implementation using arrays is EASY (simple) to implement.
Accessing elements in an array is FAST due to direct indexing.
Stack operations like push and pop take O(1) (constant) time in array implementation.
Arrays provide STATIC memory allocation at compile time.
Array-based stacks have CONTIGUOUS (cache-friendly) memory access, improving performance.
There is no overhead of memory allocation and DEALLOCATION (pointer management) in arrays.
Array-based stack implementation avoids the extra memory used for POINTERS in linked lists.
It is easier to IMPLEMENT (code) a stack implemented using arrays in programming.
Array implementation of stack is EFFICIENT in terms of memory for small, fixed-size stacks.
Stack overflow in array implementation is EASY to detect.
II. Disadvantages of Array Implementation
Stack implemented using arrays has a fixed MAXIMUM size.
If the stack size is too small, it may lead to OVERFLOW.
If the stack size is too large, it may lead to WASTAGE of memory.
Arrays use STATIC memory allocation, which is less flexible.
It is difficult to RESIZE the size of a stack implemented using arrays at runtime.
Stack operations using arrays are not memory EFFICIENT for large data.
Inserting or removing elements from the stack may require checking for OVERFLOW or underflow.
Reallocation of array memory is COSTLY and not always supported in some languages.
Array implementation is not suitable when the maximum stack size is UNKNOWN (unpredictable).
Stack implemented using arrays may not efficiently use MEMORY in dynamic scenarios.
III. Applications of Stacks
Stacks are used in EXPRESSION evaluation and conversion.
Infix, postfix, and prefix expressions are evaluated using STACKS.
Stacks help in checking balanced PARENTHESES in an expression.
Stack is used to perform DEPTH-FIRST traversal in trees.
The function call mechanism uses a CALL stack.
Stacks are used in BACKTRACKING algorithms for backtracking.
Undo and redo operations in editors are managed using STACKS.
Stack is used in reversing a STRING (list).
Browser history navigation (back and forward) uses the concept of STACKS.
Stacks are used in memory management and RECURSION handling in programs.
